write_up: Your resume tells a clear story from object storage at Nimbus Cloud to fraud, reconciliation, and ledger work at Brightline Payments. I read it for Staff Software Engineer roles. A recruiter can see the technical leadership and would likely move it forward with questions about how big the team and platform are.

The idempotency line is the model: you name the framework, its adoption across payment services, and the duplicate-charge incidents it eliminated. Your Experience section leads, and the staff headline is backed by the work underneath it. What’s missing is a comparable measure of the team you lead and what the ledger redesign changed.

Start with the Brightline staff role. Add the team size and a measure of the ledger redesign if you can substantiate them, then sharpen the older lines that leave your contribution or the change unclear.
